decision_rules_fixed_before_model_result.fallback: Use the first nonblank source in the fixed order only when every earlier source is blank.
decision_rules_fixed_before_model_result.conflict: If any available sources contain different normalized nonblank categories, raw result is Conflict and model category is Not available.
decision_rules_fixed_before_model_result.binary: Only Positive and Negative are model-available. Indeterminate, Equivocal, Not Evaluated, Performed but Not Available, Conflict, blank, and every other category are Not available.
decision_rules_fixed_before_model_result.pam50: Availability only; never used as a Phase 15 model input.

matching.rule: Upper-case sampleID; restrict Xena sample type to 01; match first 12 characters to corrected cohort participant barcode.
